panels.description: These two timeseries share the dashboard time range. They measure different things.

options.content:
**Edge hits are not page views.** CloudWatch `AWS/CloudFront` Requests counts every object at the CDN (HTML, JS, images, bots, health checks). Cloudflare Web Analytics counts browsers that ran `beacon.min.js`. Asset distributions (`assets`, `news-data`) have **no** beacon.

Expect Cloudflare page views << CloudFront requests. If they match, something is wrong. JS-blocked clients, 5xx that never returned HTML, and cache-only asset traffic never appear here.
